fusions.name: Measured Litany
fusions.desc: Takes 1.5 seconds to recite, then looses 4 words of power at once, spread apart, each dealing 8 damage that ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Spoken Correction
fusions.desc: Speaks a correcting word that deals 9 damage to the first enemy it meets. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Recited Again
fusions.desc: Takes 1.5 seconds to recite, then clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

fusions.name: Measured Breath
fusions.desc: When you spend mana, you regain 2 mana a second for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
